tuples.subject: fixed_rate_switch_offer
tuples.quote: (2) At the time of reset of interest rates, a bank may, at its option, provide a choice to the borrowers to switch over to a fixed rate as per its policy approved by the Board or a Committee to which powers have been delegated by the Board30.

tuples.subject: fixed_rate_switch_offer
tuples.quote: The policy, inter alia, may also specify the number of times a borrower will be allowed to switch during the tenor of the loan.
